title: IELTS GT Writing Practice Test 23 — Recommendation Letter
instructions: Task 1: Write a letter of at least 150 words. Task 2: Write an essay of at least 250 words.

questions.letterSituation: Your university classmate Sam is applying for a highly competitive scholarship to fund postgraduate study at a university overseas. The scholarship committee requires two personal character references from people who know the applicant well. Sam has asked you to write one of these references.
questions.prompt:
Your university classmate Sam is applying for a highly competitive scholarship to fund postgraduate study at a university overseas. The scholarship committee requires two personal character references from people who know the applicant well. Sam has asked you to write one of these references.

Write a letter in response to this situation. In your letter:
• introduce yourself and describe your relationship with Sam and how long you have known each other
• give specific examples of Sam's academic strengths, personal character, and determination
• state clearly and enthusiastically why you believe Sam is a highly deserving candidate for this scholarship

Write at least 150 words. You do NOT need to write any addresses.
questions.modelAnswer: A strong response should open with an appropriate greeting, address each bullet point in a separate paragraph with specific detail, maintain the correct register throughout, and close with a suitable sign-off.

questions.prompt: Some people think that scholarship and bursary programmes should prioritise students from economically disadvantaged backgrounds. Others believe scholarships should be awarded purely on the basis of academic merit. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
questions.modelAnswer: A strong response should present a clear position supported by well-developed arguments, relevant specific examples, and a logical structure including a focused introduction, detailed body paragraphs, and a concise conclusion.
